name: @nakdev-npm/novanode
description: NovaNode Asterisk telephony DevKit and Claude/Codex usage TUI
author: Nacho Gonzalez <nachogonzalez.dev@gmail.com>

scripts.check: bash -n bin/nn bin/nn-pbx bin/nn-usage bin/usage bin/nn-op bin/nnop bin/op bin/novanode && env PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/novanode-pycache python3 -m compileall -q bin/lib && env PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/novanode-pycache python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && env PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/novanode-pycache python3 bin/lib/main.py --version && env PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/novanode-pycache python3 bin/lib/op_cli.py --version
